# volcano_project_auth_config (Resource)

A project's end-user authentication configuration. This is a singleton every project already has, so there is no create/delete on the API side - Create performs the first PUT and Delete is a local no-op (removing this resource from configuration does not reset the project to defaults).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project_auth_config" "example" {
  project_id                 = volcano_project.example.id
  enable_signup              = true
  enable_email_password      = true
  require_email_confirmation = true
  min_password_length        = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds.
- `allow_password_reset` (Boolean) Whether users may reset their password.
- `allowed_email_domains` (List of String) Email domains allowed to sign up/in. Empty means no restriction.
- `allowed_email_domains_mode` (String)
- `allowed_redirect_urls` (List of String) Redirect URLs allowed after OAuth/email flows.
- `auto_link_verified_oauth` (Boolean) Automatically link OAuth identities with a verified, matching email to an existing account.
- `cors_allow_credentials` (Boolean) Whether CORS responses include credentials.
- `cors_max_age` (Number) CORS preflight cache duration in seconds.
- `device_verification_url` (String) URL shown during CLI device-code login.
- `email_confirmation_subject` (String) Subject line for the signup confirmation email.
- `email_confirmation_timeout` (Number) Seconds an email confirmation link remains valid.
- `email_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the project sends auth emails at all.
- `email_from_address` (String) From address for auth emails.
- `email_from_name` (String) From display name for auth emails.
- `email_password_changed_subject` (String) Subject line for the password-changed notification email.
- `email_password_reset_subject` (String) Subject line for the password-reset email.
- `enable_anonymous_signins` (Boolean) Whether anonymous sign-in is allowed.
- `enable_email_password` (Boolean) Whether email/password sign-in is allowed.
- `enable_signup` (Boolean) Whether new signups are allowed.
- `inactivity_timeout` (Number) Seconds of inactivity before a session is invalidated.
- `managed_auth_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Volcano's hosted auth pages are enabled.
- `max_password_history` (Number) Number of previous passwords a user may not reuse.
- `max_session_duration` (Number) Maximum session duration in seconds, regardless of activity.
- `min_password_length` (Number) Minimum password length.
- `password_reset_timeout` (Number) Seconds a password-reset link remains valid.
- `post_auth_redirect_url` (String) Default redirect URL after successful authentication.
- `post_logout_redirect_url` (String) Default redirect URL after logout.
- `rate_limit_signin` (Number) Max sign-in attempts per window.
- `rate_limit_signup` (Number) Max signups per window.
- `rate_limit_token_refresh` (Number) Max token refreshes per window.
- `refresh_token_lifetime` (Number) Refresh token lifetime in seconds.
- `require_email_confirmation` (Boolean) Whether a new signup must confirm their email before signing in.
- `require_lowercase` (Boolean) Whether passwords must contain a lowercase letter.
- `require_numbers` (Boolean) Whether passwords must contain a digit.
- `require_special_chars` (Boolean) Whether passwords must contain a special character.
- `require_uppercase` (Boolean) Whether passwords must contain an uppercase letter.
- `smtp_host` (String) Custom SMTP host. Omit to use the platform's default email sender.
- `smtp_password` (String, Sensitive) Custom SMTP password. Write-only: the API never returns it, so this value is preserved as-is across Read once set.
- `smtp_port` (Number) Custom SMTP port.
- `smtp_use_tls` (Boolean) Whether to use TLS for custom SMTP.
- `smtp_username` (String) Custom SMTP username.

### Read-Only

- `cors_allowed_origins` (List of String) Derived from allowed_redirect_urls; not independently settable.
- `cors_enabled` (Boolean)
- `platform_token_ttl` (Number)
- `smtp_password_configured` (Boolean) Whether a custom SMTP password is currently set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project_auth_config.example <project-id>
```
